item.title: Grand Opening
item.description: When you least expect it, a blessing falls into your path. May 25th marks the grand opening of our first official and over all official Head Quarters and Studios. Team Que Rico Ottawa was on hand to witness this momentous occasion that definitely changes how we operate and conduct our journey. Radio Que Rico Pasito Pasito Suave Suavecito, pero logrando metas originales y siempre dando luz a nuestra bella comunidad Latino Americana!

item.title: The Soul of the Caribbean
item.description: The Soul of the Caribbean: Why We’re Still Dancing to Joe ArroyoIf you ever found yourself swept away by a salsa beat that feels like it’s pulsing straight from the heart ofthe coast, you’ve likely felt the magic of Alvaro Jose “Joe” Arroyo Gonzalez.Born in the sun-drenched streets of Cartagena, Colombia, in 1955, Joe wasn’t just a singer; he was abridge-builder.
